ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a marine food chain. There is an arrow from the Sun to algae, an arrow from algae to small marine animals, an arrow from small marine animals to fish, and an arrow from fish to humans. Reasoning: In this chain, fish eat or consume the small marine animals. If humans removed all the fish from the water, the small marine animals would lose a major predator. With less predation from fish, their population would increase.
